owner: CheckoutPreviews over the existing ShoppingCart, growthCustomer and native contentDigest owners
preview_schema: FrozenCheckoutPreview in checkout-preview.mts; all amounts are canonical nonnegative decimal minor-unit strings with at most 24 digits
merchant_identity: The existing authenticated store_id is merchant_id in this synthetic profile; no additional merchant registry is inferred.
authority: Every prepare/read/revalidate requires an opaque current customer Scope bound to the actual cart order/customer, current proof, privacy and recovery checks. A synchronous final observation follows the last await before returning or retaining a snapshot.
sources: A confirmed active native cart, current native catalog facts and explicit shipping/fee observations. Changed price, stock, terms, cart owner, quote scope, quote revision or expiry fails closed. Native source rounding limitations remain in force.
snapshot_ownership: Server-generated IDs address private frozen snapshots. Public lookup never accepts a caller-supplied preview object. The original created_at, expires_at, digest and purchase facts are retained through revalidation.
privacy: Bounded process-local snapshots contain IDs, monetary facts and terms digests, not proof/session tokens, addresses or source payloads. Expired entries are swept on access; close clears owner state. Reads recheck current customer/privacy authority. Restart loses snapshots; no export/import restores authority. Caller-held copies and independent synthetic fixtures require separate cleanup; physical erasure is not claimed.
effects: Preview operations create no purchase, payment, stock reservation, action approval or checkout operation. Normal kernel authorization may update session last_seen.
